description: This file defines a UI widget class 'LogModeWidget' for toggling logging modes via a checkbox. It creates a panel with a checkbox, and when the checkbox state changes, it sends a command to the command queue.

classes.name: LogModeWidget
classes.description: A UI component representing a checkbox to toggle logging mode, which sends a command when toggled.

methods.name: LogModeWidget
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the widget UI and defines the checkbox action.

methods.name: getPanel
methods.description: Returns the JPanel container of this widget.
